manage.confirmMismatch: Type the centre’s name exactly to confirm.

manage.reactivatedNotice: Centre reactivated. Its members can use the dashboard again.

manage.planRetired: That plan is retired and takes no new centres.
manage.paidSubscription: This centre pays through a billing provider. Change the plan in the provider’s dashboard instead.
manage.planOverriddenNotice: Plan updated. New limits apply immediately.

manage.noOtherPlans: There is no other active plan to move this centre to.
manage.suspendSubtitle: Every member loses the dashboard and the extension at once. Nothing is deleted, and you can reactivate at any time.
manage.reactivateSubtitle: Restores the dashboard and the extension for every member.

schemes.title: Scheme catalogue
schemes.subtitle: The global catalogue every centre reads. A centre’s own private schemes are their data and are not listed here.
schemes.newSubtitle: Saved as a draft. It reaches centres only once it is published.
schemes.editSubtitle: Changes here reach every centre in the country.
schemes.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, slug or portal
schemes.emptyHelp: Adjust the search, or create one.
schemes.invalidRows: {count} row(s) in the catalogue fail validation and are hidden from centres. Open them to repair the bad field.
schemes.builtInsWithoutRow: {count} built-in scheme(s) have no catalogue row, so their countdown stays silent until somebody enters a real window.
schemes.builtInsSubtitle: These ship in the build and are visible to centres, but carry no application dates. Creating a row with the same slug lets you track a live window.
schemes.sectionCopyHelp: Both languages are required — an operator reads these aloud at the counter.
schemes.sectionWindowHelp: Leave the dates empty when no window has been published. A silent countdown is better than a wrong one.
schemes.sectionEligibilityHelp: Validated against the same schema the matcher reads. A malformed criterion would widen eligibility rather than narrow it, so the form refuses to save until this parses.
schemes.slugHint: Lowercase, hyphenated. Overrides a built-in of the same slug.
schemes.adapterSlugHint: Links to a portal adapter when the extension can autofill this form.
schemes.notificationUrlHint: The page an operator is pointed at before starting an application.
schemes.noWindowHint: Leave all three empty when no window has been published.
schemes.operatorFeeHint: Not a government fee and not a price Assistigo sets.
schemes.cannotPublishNote: Your role can edit schemes but not publish them. Save your changes and ask a Super Admin or Content Manager to publish.
schemes.readOnly: Your role can view this scheme but not change it.
schemes.unpublished: Scheme unpublished. Centres no longer see it.
schemes.slugTaken: A global scheme with this slug already exists.
schemes.evergreenHasEndDate: A scheme cannot be open all year and also have a closing date.
schemes.dangerHelp: These change what every centre sees, immediately.
schemes.confirmDelete: Delete this global scheme? Every centre loses it immediately and there is no undo.
schemes.builtInFallbackNote: Deleting a row whose slug matches a built-in scheme falls back to the built-in, which ships with no application dates.
schemes.logoHelp: Shown on this scheme’s cards in the Schemes & vacancies hub. Without one, the cards show the category icon.
schemes.logoRules: Square PNG, JPEG or WebP, at least 128 × 128 px, up to 256 KB. Upload only artwork you have permission to use.
schemes.logoSaved: Logo saved. It shows on the hub wherever this scheme is published.
schemes.logoRemoved: Logo removed. The cards show the category icon again.
schemes.logoTooLarge: That file is larger than 256 KB. Export a smaller version and try again.
schemes.logoWrongType: Only PNG, JPEG and WebP images are accepted.
schemes.imagesHelp: The logo on the hub cards, and the banner and illustration on this scheme’s detail page. Each is optional and changes live without re-publishing.
schemes.bannerHelp: Wide picture behind the top of the scheme’s detail page. Without one, the header shows a plain blue gradient.
schemes.bannerRules: Landscape PNG, JPEG or WebP, about 1376 × 768 px, up to 1 MB. Keep the left third plain — the title sits over it — and avoid words in the picture, which cannot be translated. Upload only artwork you have permission to use.
schemes.bannerSaved: Banner saved. It shows on the detail page wherever this scheme is published.
schemes.bannerRemoved: Banner removed. The detail page header is a plain gradient again.
schemes.bannerTooLarge: That file is larger than 1 MB. Export a smaller version and try again.
schemes.illustrationHelp: Picture beside “What the customer gets” on the detail page. Hidden on small screens.
schemes.illustrationRules: Square PNG, JPEG or WebP on a white or transparent background, at least 512 × 512 px, up to 512 KB. Upload only artwork you have permission to use.
schemes.illustrationSaved: Illustration saved. It shows on the detail page wherever this scheme is published.
schemes.illustrationTooLarge: That file is larger than 512 KB. Export a smaller version and try again.

deadlines.title: Live deadlines
deadlines.subtitle: Every global scheme’s application window, ordered by what needs attention first. Expired windows lead, because a published scheme whose date has passed is actively misleading centres.

deadlines.noExpired: No published scheme has a lapsed window. The catalogue is telling the truth today.
deadlines.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, slug or portal

forms.title: Portal forms
forms.subtitle: Global portal adapters — the forms the extension knows how to fill.
forms.safetyNote: Field mappings are not editable here. A mapping is produced and tested against a real form by the extension tooling; hand-editing the thing that decides what gets typed into a citizen’s application does not belong in a text box.
forms.searchPlaceholder: Search by portal, form or region
forms.mappingsNote: Mappings and URL patterns are managed by the extension tooling.
forms.emptyHelp: Adapters ship with the build and are seeded by npm run db:seed:adapters.

scrapers.title: Scraper sources
scrapers.subtitle: Public government notification pages the ingestion pipeline watches.
scrapers.newSubtitle: Point the pipeline at a public notification page.
scrapers.reviewNote: Nothing a scraper produces goes live. Every candidate lands in the review queue and is published only when a person approves the diff.
scrapers.httpEnabledNote: Outbound HTTP fetching is ENABLED for this deployment. Sources using the HTTP fetcher will make requests to their configured page, subject to the host allowlist and robots.txt.
scrapers.httpDisabledNote: Outbound HTTP fetching is off for this deployment (SCRAPER_HTTP_ENABLED). {count} source(s) using the HTTP fetcher will stage nothing until it is enabled. Manual and fixture sources are unaffected.
scrapers.httpDisabledNoteShort: Outbound fetching is off, so this source cannot run.
scrapers.httpFormNote: The HTTP fetcher only reads dates from a page you name, for a scheme you name. It never logs in, never submits anything and never reads a CAPTCHA. The host must be on the allowlist and robots.txt must permit the path.
scrapers.emptyHelp: Create one to start tracking a notification page.
scrapers.configSubtitle: What we watch, how often, and how it is read.
scrapers.name: Name
scrapers.slugHint: Lowercase, hyphenated. Used in run logs.
scrapers.sourceUrlHint: Must be a public https page. Never a page behind a login.
scrapers.slugTaken: A source with this slug already exists.
scrapers.hostNotAllowed: This host is not on the fetcher allowlist. Add it to SCRAPER_ALLOWED_HOSTS, or use the manual fetcher.
scrapers.httpsRequired: The source URL must start with https://.

fetcherHint.manual: A person pastes the notification and the dates are read out of it. Needs no network.
fetcherHint.fixture: Candidates come from this source’s own config. Used for demos and tests.
fetcherHint.http: Fetches the page over the network. Requires the deployment switch to be on.

fetcherConfigHelp.manual: The manual fetcher takes its input at run time and needs no stored options.
fetcherConfigHelp.fixture: Put candidates under an "items" array, each shaped like a staged candidate.
fetcherConfigHelp.http: Set "schemeSlug" to the catalogue slug this page reports dates for.

scrapers.configNotObject: Options must be a JSON object.
scrapers.configNoCredentials: Options must not contain credentials. A source that needs a login is one we are not entitled to scrape.
scrapers.runSubtitle: Whatever this finds goes to the review queue, never straight to the catalogue.
scrapers.runFailed: The run failed. See the history below.
scrapers.manualNeedsInput: Paste the notification text and name the scheme it is about.
scrapers.httpDisabled: Outbound fetching is off for this deployment, so this source cannot run.
scrapers.targetSchemeHint: Which catalogue scheme this notification is about.
scrapers.pastedTextHint: Paste the notification. Only the dates read out of it are stored — the text itself is never saved.
scrapers.stagedNext: Open the review queue to approve or reject what was staged.
scrapers.historySubtitle: The last 20 runs for this source.
scrapers.noRuns: This source has not run yet.
scrapers.confirmDelete: Delete this source? Its run history goes with it.
scrapers.deleteNote: Queue items already published to the catalogue stay published. Pending ones are removed with the source.
scrapers.fetchFailed: The source page could not be fetched. The run has been recorded as failed.
scrapers.manualInputInvalid: Paste the notification text and name the scheme it is about.

queue.subtitle: Scraped candidates waiting on a human decision.

queue.notFound: That queue item no longer exists.
queue.emptyInboxHelp: Run a scraper source to stage candidates for review.

team.subtitle: Internal staff with access to this panel.
team.privacyNote: Being on this roster grants no access to customer data. Reading a centre’s records still requires a time-limited, reasoned and audited support access grant.

team.grantSubtitle: The person must already have a Bharatfill account.

team.rosterSubtitle: Revoking keeps the row so the audit trail stays attached to it.
team.emptyHelp: Grant access to an existing account above.
team.userNotFound: No Bharatfill account uses that email address.
team.notFound: That roster entry no longer exists.

team.roleGuideSubtitle: What each role can do, and which login page it uses.

roleGuide.super_admin: Everything, including team access, channels, centre suspension, plan management and billing overrides.

roleGuide.scraper_operator: Configures and runs scraper sources. Cannot publish what they bring back.
roleGuide.support_admin: Read-only across analytics, centres, the catalogue, pipeline and audit log.
